alpaca_fresh.rule: no input field, 20-140 characters, not in data/ or any round 4 set; development if sha1(normalised text) mod 5 == 0

itw.rule: templates split by community id (templates without one by their own hash), development if sha1(group) mod 5 == 0, at most 6 (development) or 12 (frozen) templates per community; questions split by sha1 mod 5; no template and no question on both sides

multijail.rule: split by request id (sha1('mj-<id>') mod 5 == 0 is development), so the 10 language versions of a request share a side; 140 of the remaining requests sampled for the frozen slice

phtest.rule: harmless and controversial sampled apart; development if sha1(normalised request) mod 5 == 0

jbb.rule: behaviours in our harmful fit half form the pool (only GCG and PAIR of the pool may enter a refit); behaviours in the eval half are held out and split by sha1(id) mod 2 into development and frozen; duplicates of a prompt across target models are kept once
jbb.cleanliness: the vicuna GCG and PAIR prompts of held-out behaviours (flag seen_r4) were run under v1 and the control in round 4 and their aggregate rates were read; nothing was fit or tuned on them. Every other artifact was never run.

transplants.note: a published GCG suffix (from the pool, development or frozen behaviours, matching the side of the set) appended to another request; labelled by the request

fresh.note: wj5_h_frz: eval-split adversarial_harmful rows never used in rounds 3 or 4. wj5_b_frz: train-split adversarial_benign rows whose vanilla request is in the frozen partition (8-9) and that were not drawn in round 4; no cluster labels, so no held-out-tactic split this time.

kept_with_caveat.note: JBC and random search wrap every behaviour in one fixed published template; development holds the same template (other behaviours, and in-the-wild template [855]). Held out by behaviour only. Neither template is in any fit row.

sorry.rule: split by question id (sha1('sorry-<id>') mod 5 == 0 is development), so the 21 styles of a question share a side; 20 development and 40 frozen questions per style; candidates equal or near (3-gram Jaccard >= 0.85) to a plain harmful row already in the sets are skipped; text stays private (the licence forbids redistribution)

plain_pair.why: the plain harmful / harmless pair that the teammate's CAST work reports on (SORRY-Bench against Alpaca), for a common yardstick
